messages:
brenda: RFC follow-up: need a final call on deployment-scoped controls. Options: keep tenant-only, add per-deploy endpoints, or a single endpoint with explicit scope field. quick takes?

tom: single endpoint with explicit scope is my vote. Cleaner surface and fewer endpoints to maintain.

ishaan: okay but must be gated. hosted tenants should not be able to mutate deploy-scoped settings unless enrolled. RBAC + audit required. Also include a clear precedence rule: deploy override > tenant config > system default.

brenda: runtime constraint: router must normalize scope+deploy_id into request context on ingress so hot-path code doesn't parse params. batching/cache key decisions depend on that.

ci-bot: ci-bot: note - test traces show header x-scope/x-deploy-id propagate to runtime as trace tags when present.

tom: caching compromise: only include deploy_id in cache/batch keys when an override exists or scope==deployment. prevents keyspace explosion.

ishaan: telemetry: add tags scope and policy_source and emit override_applied flag. Also ensure billing tags propagate when deploy pins a larger model.

brenda: UX: hosted tenants get a console confirmation flow for sensitive deploy-scoped writes. API returns 409 "confirm via console" if not confirmed. Dedicated/private use API if role allowed.

tom: rollout plan: RFC + docs, console opt-in, router normalization, runtime flag for cache split, Dedicated canary 2 weeks.

brenda: action items: ishaan - doc cache key logic and perf estimate; tom - router normalization PR; I'll draft the RFC with API examples and the console flow. Reconvene after draft.
